pages.title: Acetoa
pages.intro: Acetoa or the Republic of Acetoa is a Unitary parliamentary republic located in North Acrola. Covering a total area of 388,005 square kilometres (approximately 131,864 square miles), the nation ranks 82nd globally in area. Acetoa borders Areoix Lie to the north, Feio Lie to the south, and Saa to the east. Its capital and largest urban centre is Yezhito, which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities. As of 1765 AFA, Acetoa has an estimated population of approximately 11.2 million people, predominantly identifying as Acetoan and speaking the official Arten language.

pages.title: Acrana
pages.intro: Acrana, officially the Republic of Acrana, is a country in Acrola, spanning the Samarran Mountain range of Ayuma. It is bordered by Praesyu to the north, Ealdorii to the east, Zenashan to the south and the Vihsanna Ocean and Nasuanian Sea to the west. Samaru is the capital, largest city and financial centre.

pages.title: Acrola
pages.intro: Acrola is a continent located in the northern and southern hemisphere. It is bordered by the Ayuma to the north, the Diairesi Sea to the west, Hinsakian Ocean to the east, and Mahea to the south. The continent covers around of land, making it the 3rd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,070,070,000 as of 1765, making it also the 4th largest continent by population behind, Mahea, Massir and Quia.

pages.title: Aetintio
pages.intro: Aetintio, officially the Federal Republic of Aetintio, is a country in Western Atirha. It is bordered on the east by Lasri, on the north by New Misos, and on the south by the Northern Eanif Ocean. Aetintio's capital and largest city is Elora. Aetintio's population in 1765 was estimated to be about 1.4 million.

pages.title: Ahokini
pages.intro: Ahokini, officially the Republic of Ahokini. It is bordered by Quidic to the east and Verste to the south. The country has a population of approximately twenty million. Its capital and most populous city is Ribash. The country is renowned for its ancient temples, including the Global Heritage Site of Krulasas Ligen, and for showcasing a diverse range of architectural styles from various historical eras.

pages.title: Alomara
pages.intro: The Alomara is a desert spanning across Quia. With an area of 7,491,042 square kilometres (4,654,717 sq mi), it is the largest hot desert in the world and the largest desert overall. The name "Alomara" is derived from Verstian: Alomra, a broken plural form of aloma', meaning "desert".

pages.title: Alzuria (region)
pages.intro: Alzuria is a historical region of Central Ayuma situated within the Tusil–Vixon river system, it is also called the Birthplace of Civilisation. It corresponds roughly to the territory of modern Ealdorii, Zenashan, and Ukhdari. Just beyond it lies in the north lies the Taiylsh Desert, where the region transitions into a desert, marking the shift from the Alzurian to Sursian.

pages.title: Amcha
pages.intro: The Federal Republic of Amchan, commonly known as Amchan, is a sovereign unitary parliamentary republic located in the region of South Mahea. Spanning a total area of 363,049 square kilometres (140,174 sq mi), it is the world’s 85th largest nation by landmass. Amchan is bordered by Inrea to the west, Ocaun to the north, and the Haanian Ocean to the east. As of the 1765 estimate, the nation had a population of approximately 2,236,000 people. Its capital and largest city is Harnuk, which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities.

pages.title: Amnant Mountains
pages.intro: thumb|Pond on the Sinsti River The Amnant Mountains or simply the Amnants, are a mountain range in Ayuma that runs north–south mostly through Estijan, from the coast of the Rianian Ocean to the Samarran Mountains near Tonder.. The average altitudes of the Amnants are around , the highest point being Mount Laadnaya, which reaches a height of .

pages.title: Andsaudare
pages.intro: Andsaudare, officially the Federal Republic of Andsaudare, is a country located in New Ayre. In simple terms, the country's geography consists of the western and southern Fedaean Mountains and desert inland to the east. More in detail, the country features a diverse geography, including the vast Red Desert, the coastal rainforest, temperate valleys, the high-altitude Goaias plateau, snow-capped peaks, and mountains, encompassing a wide range of climates and biomes across its regions and cities. It is bordered by Prstreula, Ohtina and United Delet to the north, Umarcia to the east, and Iainoa to the south. The seat of government and largest city is Ravalor, which contains the executive, legislative, and electoral branches of government, while the constitutional capital is Minjari, the seat of the judiciary.

pages.title: Anymna
pages.intro: Anymna, officially the Federal Republic of Anymna, is a country in north Quia. It is mainly situated in the Kertesen mountain range. It borders Zhanshe to the north, Ztesh and Yihnurda to the west, and Onphello to the east, with the northern Eanif ocean to the north. Anymna has a diverse geography, including fertile plains, forested hills, and one of the world's ten tallest mountains. Khureldai is the nation's capital and its largest city. Anymna is a multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-religious, and multi-cultural state, with Anymnan as the official language. The name "Anymna" is first recorded in texts from the famous Tavalan explorer Breturside in 1333.

pages.title: Aplasia
pages.intro: Aplasia, officially the Republic of Aplasia, is a country on the northwestern coast of New Ayre. Yondhu is the capital of Aplasia and is also the country's largest city. Aplasia is bordered by the Rianian Ocean to the north, the Etirhan province of Moaneill to the south and southeast, and Maalle to the west. It is part of The Demeeri.

pages.title: Arbiya
pages.intro: Arbiya, officially the Republic of Arbiya, is a sovereign landlocked country located in the northern hemisphere. It is a unitary parliamentary republic bordered by Raledria to the south, from which it shares a deep-seated and complex historical lineage, Gaeiya to the west and Genaire to the north. It spans an area of 551,835 square kilometres (213,065 sq mi), and it is the 60th largest nation by land area. It has a population of approximately 6.5 million. Its capital and largest metropolitan centre is Karevu, which serves as the nation’s primary hub for commerce, culture, and governance. Arbiya is a linguistically distinct nation, with Lycroan serving as the official language, while Emaran holds significant status as a recognised regional language, with most residents able to speak both fluently.

pages.title: Ashain
pages.intro: Ashain officially the Republic of Ashain, is an island country in west Quia. Located between the Haanian and Great Hinsakian oceans off the south and north coasts of the mainland, respectively, it is bordered to the east by the Ashanian Sea and borders Ahokini. The island of Ashain and the Asstia archipelago consists which consists of over 10,000 smaller islands, covering 422,225 square kilometres (163,022 sq mi). Divided into 17 prefectures and 13 island territories, around three-quarters of the country's terrain is mountainous and heavily forested, concentrating its agriculture and highly urbanised population along its coastal plains. With a population of over 62 million as of 1765, it is the 26th most populous country. The country's capital and largest city is Sjoran.

pages.title: Astye
pages.intro: Astye, officially the Federal Republic of Astye, is a country located in New Ayre. Astye is bordered by the Sahare Gulf to the north, the United Delet to the east and northeast, and Ohtina to the west. Astye is divided into 30 departments. The Capital District of Kavirro is also the country's largest city, hosting the main financial and cultural hub. Other major urban areas include Golnashi, Losari, Pelamir, Vintago, Tirema, Saravo, Sharika, Zumelo and Dravento. It covers an area of 529,951 square kilometres (204,615 sq mi) and has a population of around 44 million. Its rich cultural heritage—including language, religion, cuisine, and art—reflects its history as a colony, fusing cultural elements brought by immigration from Ayuma and Massir, with those brought by the Quian diaspora, as well as with those of the various Indigenous civilisations that predate colonisation. Alqiran is the official language, although 37 other languages are recognised regionally.

pages.title: Atirha
pages.intro: Atirha is a continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered by the Srandan Ocean to the north, Rianian Ocean to the east, and the Northern Eanif Ocean south and east, and Usscea Bay the south. The continent covers around of land, making it the 6nd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 538,280,000 as of 1765, making it also the 6th largest continent by population behind Massir, Mahea, Quia, Acrola and Ayuma.

pages.title: Ayuma
pages.intro: Ayuma is a continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered by the Srandan Ocean to the north, the Rianian Ocean to the west, Hinsakian Ocean to the east, and the Vihsanna Ocean and Nasianian Sea to the south. The continent covers around of land, making it the 2nd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,020,200,000 as of 1765, making it also the 5th largest continent by population behind Acrola, Mahea, Massir and Quia.

pages.title: Backstab War
pages.intro: The Backstab War was a conflict which led to the secession of the southern provinces (mainly the former Southern Laselteh) from the Republic of Laselteh and the establishment of an independent First Republic of Grazail.

pages.title: Baluyde
pages.intro: Baluyde, officially the Republic of Baluyde, is a country in North Quia and the Prwwnsa archipelago, between the Northern Eanif and Great Hinsakian oceans. Comprising over 7000 islands, Baluyde is the world's 150th-largest country by area, at 15,195 square kilometres (5,867 square miles). Baluyde has significant areas of wilderness that support one of the world's highest levels of biodiversity. It shards a borders with Wundry on the small island of Xaaoapwa, as well as maritime borders with Shomjind.

pages.title: Blue River
pages.intro: thumb|360x360px|Bridge crossing the Blue river, near Damiran The Blue River is one of the longest river in Ayuma. Situated in Estijan, it flows through Central Estijan to northern Estijan and into the Sarwun Strait and Rianian Ocean. The Blue River has a length of , and a catchment area of . It is also Ayumas second largest river in terms of average discharge at delta – between per second – and of drainage basin. It is widely regarded as the national river of Estijan. The old Yirvan States, arose along the Blue and neibouring rivers 600 AFA. Historically, the river served as an important meeting place of various Ayuman civilizations.

pages.title: Byllu
pages.intro: Byllu, officially the Republic of Byllu, is a landlocked country in South Mahea; bordering Pelugrotoa to the north, Isnti to the east, Ocaun to the south, Taing and Dual Cenryia to the west, sharing. Covering roughly 563,506 square kilometres (217,571 square miles), Byllu is the 59th largest country on Andah, and 99th largest by population.

pages.title: Candenat
pages.intro: Candenat, officially the Republic of Candenat, is a landlocked country in South Acrola. It is the eighth-largest country in Acrola and the 55th largest country in the world, with an area of over 591,613 square kilometres (228,423 sq mi). The country is bordered to the north by Iquir, Sattle and Viussi, to the east by Othya, to the south by Jathua, and to the west by Taniduna. The population of Candenat is about 27.33 million, 47.19% of whom are estimated to be under the age of 16 in 1764. Its capital and largest city is Pavrette. The country has two official languages and four recognised regional languages, of which Gieselei is the most commonly spoken.

pages.title: Canldives
pages.intro: Canldives, officially the Republic of Canldives, and historically known as the Caldiev Islands, is an archipelagic country in North Massir, located in the southern Vihsanna Ocean. Taval is located to the north, and over ___ from the Massiran continent's mainland. Candives' chain of 26 atolls and 60 islands stretches from Ihppohu Atoll in the north to Adu Atoll in the south.

pages.title: Chaenia
pages.intro: Chaenia is an island country in the central Ubrana Sea. Situated in West Mahea, its cultural identity and geopolitical orientation are overwhelmingly Seytinemasi. Chaenia is the only major island in the Ubrana Sea and is the most populous island in the Ubrana. It's mainland provinces border Seytinemas to the north and Dual Cenryia to the south, while the island borders Otiiric to the south and Eparia to the west. Its capital is Lutur and its largest city is Tibokan. Chaenia hosts the military bases of: Ashain, Areoix Lie, Dahe, Easuhura, Emara, Lycroa, and Raledria. The state of Mirran is de facto governed by the Republic of Mirran, which is Autonomous from the Republic of Chaenia.

pages.title: Cloja
pages.intro: Cloja, officially the Republic of Cloja, is a country in West Massir. It comprises the Clojan islans, and the islands of Suro and Owiaq, for a total land area of 1,325 square kilometres (512 sq mi). Cloja shares a maritime border with North Ayre to the west and Oyreain to the south. Kezapi, on the west coast of the main island, is its capital and largest city.

pages.title: Crila Republic
pages.intro: The Crila Republic is an island country and city-state in North New Ayre. Its territory comprises one main island, 6 satellite islands and islets, and one outlying islet. The country is bordered by the Sahare Gulf to the south, and Maalle across the Strait of Crila to the east.

pages.title: Crisqui
pages.intro: thumb|View along Mazhou Beach, located near Feliru, [[Heiso]] Crisqui is a historical region in North Ayuma and north Acrola encompassing the entirety of present-day Heiso, parts of the modern-day Estijan and the minor parts of Areoix Lie. The exact geographical extent varies depending on the definition: in the narrow sense, the area constituted by (Exlusing Heiso) The Arten provinces of Outer Heanuin, and Inner Heanuin, Estijan state Estijan Crisqui; The parts of Crisqui ceded to Estijan are collectively known as Northern Crisqui or Estijan Crisqui.

pages.title: Cruthi Anoso
pages.intro: Cruthi Anoso, officially known as the Republic of Cruthi Anoso, It is situated in the Haanian Ocean, is part of South Mahea, and is predominantly inhabited by Diaokiuos and a minority of Emarans. As one of the world's second smallest country, Cruthi Anoso is commonly referred to as "The Rock".

pages.title: Curata
pages.intro: Curata, officially the Republic of Curata, is a country in northwestern Central Atirha, bordered by Raledria on the north, Fincen to the east, and the Northern Eanif Ocean on the south. The country's capital and largest city is Hulong. The territory was first colonised by the Emaran Empire during early 15th century, achieving independence in 1540 as part of Raledria, from which it emerged as a sovereign state in 1612 after the Great Atirhan War. Curata became independent in 1615 and has since been a republic, although it has consistently endured much social strife and political instability. In the 1680s, the nation went through a civil war where the current constitution was established in 1680.

pages.title: Dahe
pages.intro: Dahe, officially the The Republic of Dahe, is a country in West Massir. With a population exceeding 890 million, it is the most populous country after beating Areoix Lie by over 300 million, representing 13.1% of the world population. Dahe spans the equivalent of two time zones and borders eight countries by land across an area of nearly 4.4 million square kilometres (1,710,00 sq mi)., making it the fourth-largest country by land area. The country is divided into ___ province-level divisions: ____ provinces, autonomous regions, and an autonomous capital region. Fekunza is the country's capital, while Fekhalai is its most populous city by urban area and largest financial center.

pages.title: Danocia
pages.intro: Danocia, officially the Republic of Danocia, is a country located in Northern Ayuma. It is bordered by Estijan to the south and Koruch to the north, and the Yshatan Gulf to the west. Danocia spans an area of 749,885 square kilometres (289,532 sq mi) with a population of 2.0 million. The country has a tundra climate and is administratively divided into eight regions. Tazmirak is the capital and largest city; it is administered separately as a city with special status.

pages.title: Darewa
pages.intro: Darewa, officially the Republic of Darewa, is a country in Ayuma. It extends from the [Taiylsh Desert] in the east to the plains in the west, bordered by Lydroa to the north, Estijan and Urbiqu to the east, Tonder, Eldjo and Lycroa to the south, and Verusa and Siana to the west. The territory has a varied landscape and diverse ecosystems. Darewa is composed of twenty-one areas and has a population of over 19 million people, and covers 681,553 km2 (263,149 sq mi). The capital and largest city is Shamarin; other major cities include Kiremu, Lhangashvik, Tazinul, and Vietshai.

pages.title: Deputy Mayor of Vurahi
pages.intro: The Deputy Mayor of Vurahi is the deputy head of the local government of Vurahi, Areoix Lie; currently that government takes the form of the City of Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality.

pages.title: Desaki
pages.intro: Desaki formally the Republic of Desaki, is a Myista country located on the southern half of the Quian continent. It borders United Mihili to the west and north, Far Lands to the north and east, and Iareva to the West. At 2,445,136 square kilometres (944,072 sq mi), Desaki is the 13th largest country by area, and is the fifth-largest country in Quia. Its capital is Olmurra, and largest city is Velthura. Desaki has a population of 29 million, and a low population density of 11.9 inhabitants per square kilometre (30.8/sq mi); 78% of Desakians reside in urban areas. They are mostly in the border of United Mihili and the southern half of the country. Desakian urban areas together cover under 0.5% of its land area. Desaki has a diverse climate owing to the length of the country.

pages.title: Deschon
pages.intro: Deschon, officially the United Republic of Deschon, is a country in South Acrola. It is bordered by Yoprioq to the northwest; Viussi to the north; Pelines to the northeast; the Fire coast and Rijan bu to the east; Inania to the south; and Jathua to the west. According to a 2024 estimate, Deschon has a population of around 30.6 million, making it the most populous country located entirely south of the equator in Acrola.

pages.title: Disal Nila
pages.intro: Disal Nila, officially the Republic of Disal Nila, is a country in Eastern Atirha, also considered as part of the Salal peninsula. Over 90% of its territory is covered by farms, the highest proportion of forest cover in the world. Disal Nila is bordered by Etirha to the north, the Rianian Ocean to the east, Peka to the south, and the Uscea sea to the east. It had around 7.43 million inhabitants in 1763 in an area of approximately 168,040 square kilometres (64,880 square miles). The capital and largest city is Naliti, which is home to roughly a fifth of the population.

pages.title: Dual Cenryia
pages.intro: Dual Cenryia, officially the Federal Republic of Dual Cenryia, is a country in South Mahea. It borders Chaenia, Seytinemas and Taing to the north; Byllu and Ocaun to the east; Exilium to the south; and Otiiric and the Ubrana Sea to the west. The territory has a varied landscape, diverse ecosystems, and a temperate climate. Dual Cenryia is composed of twelve provinces and is the third most populous member state in Mahea, with over 95 million people, having a land area covering 1,028,181 km2 (396,983 sq mi). The capital and largest city is Vrandig; other major cities include Panstel, Klemerda, Grimsa, Zalmar, and Krunka.

pages.title: Ealdorii
pages.intro: Ealdorii, officially the Republic of Ealdorii a country in Central Ayuma. It is bordered by Zenashan to the south, Urbiqu and Ikzen to the north, Ukhdari to the east, the Tasa Bay to the southeast, Arcana to the southwest, and Praesyu to the west. The country covers an area of 1,563,780 square kilometres (603,779 mi) and has a population of over 137 million, making it the 26th largest country by area and the 10th most populous in the world. Shurqan, home to over 13 million people, is the capital city and the largest in the country.

pages.title: Easuhura
pages.intro: The Kingdom of Easuhura, commonly known as the Easuhura , is a country in Southern Ayuma, off the coast of the continental mainland. It comprises Easuhura, Elenin, and Delare. Easuhura includes the island of Italran, and the island of Ecossi, and most of the smaller islands within the Easuhuran Isles. Easuhura is surrounded by the Vihsanna Ocean to the south, the Escaran Channel, and the Nasuanian Sea. It maintains sovereignty over the Easuhuran Overseas Territories, which are located across various oceans and seas globally. Easuhura had an estimated population of over 29.73 million people in 1764. The capital and largest city of both Italran and in Easuhura is Tanbai. The cities of Phaabai, and Sokhan are the national capitals of Elenin and Delare.

pages.title: Eldavpir
pages.intro: Eldavpir, officially the Republic of Eldavpir, is a country on the eastern coast of Middle Acrola. It is bordered by Viussi and Sattle to the south, the Iquir and Terressin to the west, Umendel to the north, and Reerica and the Hoscoara Gulf to the east. The capital and most populous city is Lunfrix.

pages.title: Eldjo
pages.intro: Eldjo is a landlocked country located at the intersection of North, West, and South Ayuma. It is bordered by Darewa and Tonder to the north, Lycroa to the west, Praesyu to the southeast, and Urbiqu to the east. Eldjo is geographically divided among the Eldjan hills, the Eldjan Plateau, and the Lake Arn De Mon to the north; hills and forests cover most of the country's territory, whereas the majority of its 5.3 million people are concentrated on the Eldjo river and its tributaries, which hosts many of the largest cities and economic centres, including Shorakim, Suveto, Xaipla, Velsar, and Jioquin.

pages.title: Elishara River
pages.intro: thumb|400x400px|Workboat on the, near Jungui The Elishara (or Lycroan Elisha ) is one of the major rivers of Ayuma. It rises in northern Darewa before traversing much of the country, then Lycroa and flowing into the North Sea in Emara, southeast of Puzhu. Its total length is .

pages.title: Elja and Munusia
pages.intro: Elja and Munusia, officially the Federal Republic of Elja and Munusia, is a country on the northern coast of New Ayre that identifies with the Demeeri and was once part of the historic Easuhuran Demeeris. Su Hitan and Mishig are both the capital of Elja and Munusia, with the latter being the country's largest city. Elja and Munusia are bordered by the Northern Eanif Ocean to the north, and Maalle to the south and east.

pages.title: Emara
pages.intro: Emara officially the Emaran Republic located primarily in South Ayuma. Its overseas regions and territories include Tiesa Canal territory, Eldas Isle, Weimrino and Lyters in the Hinsakian Ocean, and many islands in South and North Eanif Ocean, giving it one of the largest discontinuous exclusive economic zones in the world. Emara shares borders with Siana and Lycroa to the north; Also boarding Trian and Etretes with the Tiesa canal territory and a maritime border with Easuhura to the east. Its metropolitan area extends from the Druvain river to the north, Vihsanna Ocean and from the Rianian Sea to the Escaran Channel. Its 32 central regions—1 of which is overseas—span a combined area of 428,786 km2 (165,555 sq mi) and have an estimated total population of over 90.8 million as of 1765. Emara is a semi-presidential republic and its capital, largest city and main cultural and economic centre is Rivostan.

pages.title: Enina
pages.intro: Enina, officially the Republic of Enina, is an island country located in the Great Hinsakian Ocean. The Republic of Enina consists of approximately 240 islands and is the western part of the Roline Islands, while the eastern and central parts make up the Republic of Trevilla.

pages.title: Eparia
pages.intro: Eparia, officially knows as the Republic of Eparia is a nation in South Massir. It has a surface area of 125,915 square kilometres (48,616 sq mi). Eparia was the last Ayuman colonial state in the supercontinent to achieve full independence and has been dubbed "the last colony". With a population of around 4 million inhabitants, it is one of the most sparsely populated territory in Massir, consisting mainly of desert flat lands. Its capital and largest city, Tarimav located in the east, with over a third of the nation's population.

pages.title: Erkizil
pages.intro: Erkizil, officially known as the Republic of Erkizil, is a nation in West Quia. It covers an area of 522,616 km2 (201,783 sq mi), making it the twelfth-largest country in Quia. The country is bordered by Ztesh to the east, Quidic to the south, the Ashanian Sea to the west, and the Hinsakian Ocean to the north. The capital and largest city is Tiraqsi; other major urban centres include Erosan, Vellikar, Cairiso, Iktavi, Washashi, and Koyah. The western regions of the country experience a semi-arid climate in the highlands, while the central and eastern areas have tropical savanna and tropical monsoon climates, characterised by large amounts of rainfall along the coast.

pages.title: Estijan
pages.intro: Estijan, or the Federal Estijan Republic, is a country spanning across northern Ayuma. It is the largest country in the world, and extends across three time zones, sharing land borders with nine other countries. With over 260 million people, Estijan is the most populous country in Ayuma and the sixth-most populous in the world. It is a highly urbanised country, with thirty-five of its urban areas having more than 1 million inhabitants. Shabiran is the capital and largest city of Estijan, while including, is the capital and largest city of Shabiran, and the Pariaga megacluster of cities is one of the largest in the world

pages.title: Etirha
pages.intro: Etirha, officially The United Provinces of Etirha is a country in Atirha. It's seven provinces and 1 territory extend from the Uscea Sea to the Rianian Ocean, making it the world's nineteenth-largest country by total area. It borders Pelan, Gaeiya, Laselteh and Grazail to the north and Disal Nila to the South. The territory of Moaneill, located in New Ayre, borders Aplasia to the north, Maalle and Nia to the west, and Veelmit to the south. The country is characterised by a wide range of both meteorological and geological regions. With a population of over 74 million, it has widely varying population densities, with the majority residing in urban areas and other areas of the country being sparsely populated. Etirha's capital is Albiran, and its three largest metropolitan areas (excluding Albiran) are Lunru, Dazmir, and Veshtar.

pages.title: Etirhan Independence War
pages.intro: The Etirhan Independence War was a series of military conflicts in Etirha from 1641 to 1647 that resulted in the country's independence from the Merelan Empire. Part of the broader East Atirhan wars of independence, it led to the dissolution of the Merelan Dominion of Etirha.

pages.title: Etretes
pages.intro: Etretes, officially the Republic of Etretes, is a country located in South Massir in the southern hemisphere, with a (disputed) relatively small part called Abdare in Mahea. It borders the Ihner and the Kera Sea to the north; Dahe to the east; Vesozata and Eparia to the south; and the Ubrana Sea, and either Emara or Trian to the west. Etretes is home to over 18 million people; most are ethnic Trians, while Hathians are the largest ethnic minority. Officially a secular state Etretes has a significant Hathian minority population. Kajkovi is Etretes's capital and second-largest city. Todorac is its largest city and economic centre. Other major cities include Mladar, Vesmir, and Skrilja.

pages.title: Exilium
pages.intro: Exilium, formally the Exilium Republic, is a country located in South Mahea. It borders Dual Cenryia north, the Trayd Cren sea to the west, and Inrea to the south. At 452,426 square kilometres (174,683 sq mi), Exilium is the largest Folite country by both area and population, and is the twelfth-largest country. Its capital and largest city is Dulvasra. Exilium has a [[List of countries and dependencies by population|population of 25.8 million], and a low population density of 55.4 inhabitants per square kilometre (143.5/sq mi); 76% of Exilians reside in urban areas]. They are mostly in the central and western half of the country. Exilium's urban areas together cover 2.5% of its land area. Exilium has a diverse climate.

pages.title: Far Lands
pages.intro: The Far Lands is a landlocked country in South Quia. Far Lands is topographically varied, with approximately 70% of its territory being a part of the Ciniu forests, with the rest being part of the Alomara Detest to the north. It is bordered by Mestjan Hyaa to the southeast, Iareva and south, Desaki and United Mihili to the west, Zhanshe to the north, and Volver to the northeast. With a population of slightly over 1.4 million people and a comparable land area to Etirha, Far Lands is one of the most sparsely populated countries in the world. While it is not enshrined by statutory law, Far Lands is de facto the nation state of the Desakian people, who constitute nearly 5% of the population, while legally undistinguished Native Farlander people, who account for another 95%, lack full representation.

pages.title: Feio Lie
pages.intro: Feio Lie or the Republic of Feio Lie is a Federal parliamentary republic located in North Acrola. Covering a total area of 229,074 square kilometres (approximately 88,446 square miles), the nation ranks 104th globally in area. Feio Lie borders Areoix Lie to the north, Acetoa and Saa to the east, Umendel to the south, and Terressin to the west. Its capital and largest urban centre is Keliaro, which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities. As of 1765 AFA, Feio Lie has an estimated population of approximately 7.89 million people, predominantly identifying as Feian and speaking the official Arten language.

pages.title: Fermori
pages.intro: Fermori, officially the Republic of Fermori, is a country in North Ayuma. It is bordered to the northwest by the Rianian Ocean, to the south by Verusa and Uularin, and to the east by Estijan. Its capital city of Khalviro, along with the city of Zahriq, are the country's two largest urban areas. The Fermorian language, of the Surtan language family, is the official language and the first language of the majority of nearly 12.2 million people.

pages.title: Finae
pages.intro: Finae, officially the Republic of Finae, and formerly known as Esduna until 1640, is a country located in mainland eastern Quia. It shares land borders with Zhanshe to the west, Onphello to the northwest and Myla south. Its maritime boundaries include the Extraien Sea and the Northern Eanif Ocean. Finae has a population of nearly 31 million people, covers an area of approximately 440,878 km2 (170,224 sq mi). The country's capital and largest city is Hishara.

pages.title: Fincen
pages.intro: Fincen, officially the Federal Republic of Fincen, is a country in Puchala in Central Artirha In. It is bordered on the northeast by Raledria, on the northwest by Lake Uterri, to the west by Slyiaduun, the south by the Northern Eanif Ocean and to the west by Curata. Fincen's capital and largest city is Tiyomi. Fincen's population in 2024 was estimated to be 4.6 million.

pages.title: Fire Coast
pages.intro: The Fire Coast is a country in South Acrola. It is situated next to the Hinsakian Ocean to the east, and shares borders with Pelines to the northwest, Rijan Bu and Deschon to the south. The Fire Coast covers an area of 99,744 km2 (38,511 sq mi), spanning diverse ecologies, from coastal savannas to tropical rainforests. With over 7.1 million inhabitants, the Fire Coast is the ninetenth-most populous country in Acrola, and the seventh-most populous country in South Acrola specifically. The capital and largest city is Kamoraya.

pages.title: Gaeiya
pages.intro: Gaeiya, also known as the Federal Republic of Gaeiya, is a country primarily located in Central Atirha. It is a federal republic of 11 states, it borders Laselteh to the East, Etirha and Pelan to the south, and Raledria, Arbiya and Genaire. Gaeiya also asserts sovereignty over five territories in the Great Mountain Range and the Geaiyan Shield to the north. It is a megadiverse country, with the world's sixth-largest land area and 96th-largest population, exceeding 9,5 million. Its capital and largest city is Tsyanka.

pages.title: Galca
pages.intro: Galca, officially the State of Galca, is a country mainly located in South Mahea, with a relatively small island chain in East Mahea. It borders the Adrad Sea and Isnti to the north; Ocaun to the west; the Gulf of Ale to the east; and the Praosia Sea to the South. Galca is home to over 16 million people; most are ethnic Galcan, while Ocunese are the largest ethnic minority. Officially a secular state, Galca has a Galcan-majority population. Dherkiv is Galca's capital and second-largest city. Altepso is its largest city and economic centre. Other major cities include Bergadni, Tserunja, and Dindaroch.

pages.title: Genaire
pages.intro: Genaire is a country in Atirha. It's twelve provinces and two territories extend from the Srandan Ocean to the Ipfehr Bay, making it the twenty-first-largest country by total area, with the longest coastline of any country. Its borders Gaeiya and Arbiya to the east, Raledria and New Misos to the southeast, and it has a maritime border with Mentdria to the west. The country is characterised by a wide range of both meteorological and geological regions. With a population of over 15 million, it has widely varying population densities, with the majority residing in its urban areas and large areas being sparsely populated. Genaire's capital and largest city is Lishka, and its next three largest metropolitan areas are Braniv, Tarnu, and Volzian.

pages.title: Geography of Alzuria
pages.intro: thumb|The Vixon river flowing through the region of modern Praesyu in Western Alzuria. Alzuria (region) encompasses the land between the Tusil and Vixon River rivers. The Tusil gain their headwaters in the neighbouring Valmiran Mountains and further north in the Untschalle, while the Vixon gains its waters from the Samarran Mountains to the west. Both rivers are fed by numerous tributaries, and the entire river system drains the vast mountainous region. The region has a mostly Mediterranean climate, with a vast desert expanse in the north. In the extreme south, the Tusil and the Vixon unite and empty into the Kadhif Gulf.

pages.title: Grazail
pages.intro: Grazail, or officially the Republic of Grazail, is a country in Eastern Atirha, in the Mii lands. Its 25 municipalities have a total population of 3,347,590 making it the 122nd largest on Andah people in an area of 202,209 km2 (78,073 sq mi). It is bordered by Laselteh to the north, Etirha to the South, and the Rianan Ocean to the east. The capital and largest city is Mushira, while Zayden is the Old Estijan Capital and cultural centre.

pages.title: Great Imperial War
pages.intro: The Great Imperial War, or the First Great War (7th April 1661 – 29th September 1666), also known as the Imperial War, was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Lasen's and the Middle Powers. Major areas of conflict included Ayuma, Massir, as well as parts of Acrola, Mahea and Quia. The war saw important developments in weaponry including tanks, aircraft, artillery, machine guns, and chemical weapons. One of the deadliest conflicts in history, it resulted in an estimated 25 million military casualties, and 7 million civilian deaths from war-related causes and genocide.

pages.title: Guise
pages.intro: Guise, officially the Republic of Guise, is an country located at the very tip of the Salal peninsula. It borders Peka to the north, the Rianian Ocean to the south and west, and Uscea Sea to the north. Tosakaa is the largest city and capital. Guise is the second-least populous country in Atirha after Metndria, with about 830,000 inhabitants. It spans an area of 8,590 square kilometres (3,320 sq mi), making it the second smallest country in Atirha after Tomscilus at. Culturally, Guise is considered very close to Emara.

pages.title: Haiza
pages.intro: Haiza, officially the Republic of Haiza, is a country in North Massir along the Zhalrn mountains region. It is bordered by the Ucrua to the northwest, Diairesi Sea to the northeast, the Kera Sea to the east; Migoku to the south, and Shinam to the west. According to a 1765 estimate, Haiza has a population of around 20.6 million.

pages.title: Heiso
pages.intro: Heiso, officially the Heisan Republic, is a semi-transcontinental country at the boundary of Acrola and Ayuma, being a part of North Ayuma or North Acrola respectively. It is borded by the Great Hinsakian Ocean to the east, Estijan to the northeast, and to Areoix Lie to the south. Mivlo is the capital and largest city.

pages.title: Hiemuekan Desert
pages.intro: The Hiemuekan Desert is a large, cold desert and grassland region in Kaastini and in western and southern Dahe, It is the -----largest desert in the world.

pages.title: Hiwush
pages.intro: Hiwush or the Republic of Hiwush, is an island country in the Vihsanna Ocean, located at the tip of the Isarian archipelago, west of Yutnitu. It includes the main island (also called Hiwush), as well as Ranashes, Senshga, Si Keshir, and many smaller islands The islands of Hiwush and Ranashes, Isuibul, Yutnitu along with the nearby Eldas Isle (a Emaran overseas department), are part of the Hyausu Islands. The main island of Hiwush, where the population is concentrated, hosts the capital and largest city, Egatsute. The country spans and has an exclusive economic zone covering approximately .

pages.title: Hkuqo
pages.intro: Hkuqo, officially the Federal Republic of Hkuqo, is a country in Central Ayuma. Located on the western edge tip of the Moksha Mountains, it shares land borders with Ukhdari to the north, Jau to the east and Jshain to the south, and Taval to the east across the sea. The Diairesi Sea lie to the southwest of the mainland, and the Tasa Bay to the west. Hkuqo has the longest coastline on the Middle Acrola, spanning over 50 islands and four traditional geographic regions. It has a population of over 22 million. Tanshiva is the nation's capital and largest city, followed by Dhamasol and Vindasira.

pages.title: Hyelen
pages.intro: The Hyelen formaly known as the Republic of Hyelen is a unitary semi-presidential republic located in South Quia, bordered by Mesjan Hyaa to the south-southwest, Nheyes Si ti to the north, and the Southern Eanif Ocean to the East. Covering an area of 154,449 km² (59,633 sq mi), it ranks as the 120th largest country in the world. The capital and largest city is PrajuleD. The official language is Hyelenian.

pages.title: Iainoa
pages.intro: Iainoa, officially the Republic of Iainoa, is a country in South New Ayre. It is bordered to the north and west by Andsaudare, to the east by Umarcia and the Dursio Sea, and to the south by the Southern Eanif Ocean. Iainoa has a population of over 15 million, and its capital and largest city is Evue. At , Iainoa is the 91st largest country in the world, and the ninth largest in New Ayre.

pages.title: Iareva
pages.intro: Iareva is a unitary absolute monarchy located in South Quia, bordered by the Far Lands to the north, Desaki to the west, Mestjan Myaa to the east, and the Haanian Ocean to the south. Covering a vast area of 4,156,962 km² (1,605,011 sq mi), it is the 5th largest country in the world by land area, yet remains one of the most sparsely populated, with just 1.9 people per km². The capital and largest city is Droskaneth. The official languages are Verstian and Iarevan, with Desakian recognised as a regional language in the western province of Euri.

pages.title: Ihner
pages.intro: Ihner is a country in the southern region of North Massir. Situated at the crossroads of the North and the South Massir, it is bordered by Western Migoku and Migoku to the north, Etreres to the south, the Kera Sea to east, and Welenu Fana to the west; Emara lies a short distance from the coastline. Ihner has a population of more than five six and an area of . Talmeera is the country's capital and largest city.

pages.title: Ikzen
pages.intro: Ikzen is a Wikipedia:landlocked country situated in North Ayuma. About 1% of Ikzen's territory, west of the Tusil river, borders Estijan to the north, Areoix Lie to the east, Ealdorii to the south, and Urbiqu to the west. The capital is Velotha, and the country's largest city and principal cultural and economic center is Vashkiri, which served as the capital until 1741. Ikzen is the world's seventeenth-largest country by land area and the third largest landlocked country. The Untschalle Steppe and Taiylsh Desert account for nearly half of its vast territory, with the [[Valmiran Mountains ] composing the rest. Ikzen has a population of 3.1 million and one of the lowest population densities in the world, with fewer than . Ethnic Seljan constitute a majority, living along the banks of the Tusil River with the Ikzeners, inhabit the while steppes and desserts, ethnic Estijan form a small minority around the capital reigon. Officially secular, Ikzen is a Kelhari-majority country with a sizeable Tzinalli community.

pages.title: Ilicuhe
pages.intro: Ilicuhe, officially the Ilicuhe Republic, is a country in South Ayuma. It is bordered by the Praesyu to the northeast, Lycroa to the west, and the Nasuanian Sea to the south. Ilicuhe covers an area of and has a population of more than 3.2 million; its population density of ranks 38th in the world and seventh in Ayuma. The capital and largest metropolitan region is Sakhen; The Sakhen-Capital Region, whose metropolitan area comprises the City of Sakhen itself plus 12 independent municipal entities, counts over 1,600,000 inhabitants. Still, these communities are counted separately by the Ilicuhan Statistics Office with other major cities are Vantok, Vinhok, and Xauva.

pages.title: Koaissa Desert
pages.intro: The Koaissa desert is the world's second largest hot desert, covering 5,719,652 square kilometres (3,554,026 sq mi) of Massir. It ranks as the second-largest desert globally, exceeded in area only by the Alomaran Desert. The name is derived from the Alquan Koaissa, the plural form of koais, which translates literally as "desert."

pages.title: Lake Arn De Mon
pages.intro: Lake Arn De Mon (Lycroan: Arandmo) is a freshwater lake located at the western edge of the Taiylsh Desert. It is the second largest lake in Ayuma, and one of the region's foremost tourist destinations. The Elishara River provides the largest inflow of water to the lake, and the is the only outflow.

pages.title: Lycroa
pages.intro: Lycroa, officially the Federal Republic of Lycroa is a country in Ayuma and Souther Ayuma It lies north of the Escaran Channel . Its fifteenth constituent states have a total population of over 84 million in an area of 357,596 km2 (138,069 sq mi), making it the fifth most populous member state on the Ayuman cotenant. It borders Darewa to the north, Eldjo, Praesyu and Ilicuhe to the east, Emara, and Siana to the west. The nation's capital and most populous city is Jungui and its main financial centre is Liambra; the largest urban area is the Kuya.

It is bordered by the Acrola to the north, the Hinsakian Ocean to the west, Krta Sea, Ubrana Sea and Trayd Sea to the east, and the Haanian Ocean to the south. The continent covers around of land, making it the 5th largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,287,320,000 as of 1765, making it also the 2nd largest continent by population behind Massir.

pages.intro: New Ayre is a continent located in the northern and southern hemispheres. It is bordered by the Northern Eanif Ocean and the Sahare Gulf to the north, the Rianian Ocean to the east, Northern Eanif Ocean to the west, and the Southern Eanif Ocean to the south. The continent covers around of land, making it the 7th largest continent in the world, with a total of about 276,059,000 as of 1765, making it also the 7th largest continent by population behind [Massir]], Mahea, Quia, Acrola, Ayuma and Atirha.

pages.title: Oyreain
pages.intro: Oyreain, officially the Republic of Oyreain, is a country in West Massir and on the Ayre archipelago, between the Southern Eanif and Vihsanna oceans. Comprising over 2,000 islands, including Shuese, Miwa, Robliyye, and many smaller islands, Oyreain is on the world's second-largest archipelago and the 83rd-largest country by area, at 209,781 square kilometres (80,997 square miles). With over 31 million people, Oyreain is the world's fourth-fifth-most-populous country and home to the Yogito religion. Shuese, the world's fourth most populous island, is home to more than 80% of the country's population.

pages.title: Pelugrotoa
pages.intro: Pelugrotoa, officially the Republic of Pelugrotoa and historically known as Ilythichan (the official name until 1709), is a country in East Mahea. With a population of nearly 348 million, it spans 2,581,890 square kilometres (996,873 sq mi). Pelugrotoa is bordered to the north by Inania, to the west by Lieri, Seytinemas and Taing, and Byllu and Isnti to the south by the Adrad Sea; it also shares maritime borders with Sunsokua to the east and Sadain to the southeast. Thavrin is the state capital, while the largest city is Havok.

pages.title: Province of Rusiguii
pages.intro: The Province of Rusiguii was a Merelan colony and later an Etirhan province in Etirha. It was named after the Emaran town of Ruzigy in southern Emara by Captain Phiastysu Mason in 1520, its first named proprietor. In 1642, the province established an independent state and government, the Rusiguii Republic, and joined with Provinces of Etirha to form the United Provinces of Etirha.

pages.title: Quia
pages.intro: Quia is a continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered by the Hinsakian Ocean and Northern Eanif Ocean to the north, the Haainian Ocean to the west and south, Southern Eanif Ocean to the east. The continent covers around of land, making it the largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,168,890,000 as of 1765, making it also the 3rd largest continent by population behind Mahea and Massir.

pages.title: Raledria
pages.intro: The Republic of Raledria, also known as the Raledria, is a country located in Atirha. It is a federal republic of ___ states and a nature preserve district, Carion. The republic borders Genaire and Arbiya to the north, Gaeiya to the east, Curata and Fincen to the south, and New Misos to the West. It shares jurisdiction of Lake Uterri with the bordering nations. Raledria also asserts sovereignty over the Republic of Arbiya, with control over their foreign policy. It is a diverse country, with the world's fourteenth-largest land area and firth-largest population, recently exceeding 300 million.

pages.title: Raveria
pages.intro: thumb|The river Vauin in the southern [[West Raverian Plain]]Raveria, is an extensive geographical region comprising most of North Ayuma, from the Amnant Mountains in the west (with the Blue River and Rianian Ocean portion of its western boundary) to the Hinsakian Ocean in the east. It has formed a part of the sovereign territory of Estijan, and the nations of Danocia and Koruch and its predecessor states since the lengthy conquest of Raveria, which began with the fall of the Quinans peoples in 1405 and concluded with the annexation of Heiso from Areoix Lie in 1628 from the Arten-Estijan treaty. Raveria is vast and sparsely populated, covering an area of over – about three-quarters of Estijan's total area, but home to roughly a third of Estijan's population. Quzharil, Zemraya, and Pelorin are the largest cities in the area.

pages.title: Red Desert
pages.intro: The Red Desert, also known as the Olotono Desert, is the largest desert in New Ayre and is the ______ -largest desert in the world by area, occupying approxly 2,622,500 square kilometres (1,629,545 mi2). It is located primarily in Andsaudare and is bounded by theFedaea Mountains, to its south and west, and the Demeeri to its north. To the north, the desert grades into the Padeshi Savanna and the Hinitru basin. The central parts of the desert are filled with sand dunes, some of which are 300 metres (980 ft) high and span 32 kilometres (20 mi) long, are the third-largest in the world. The southern parts of the desert have gravel plains and scattered mountain outcrops.

pages.title: Red War
pages.intro: The Red War, (22 May 1688 – 3 December 1695), was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Accord and the Vanguard. Nearly all of the world's countries participated. Tanks and aircraft played major roles, the latter enabling the strategic bombing of cities. The Red War was the deadliest conflict in history, causing the death of 70 - 85 million people. Millions died in genocides, including the something, and by massacres, starvation, and disease. After the Allied victory, Lycroa, Alzuria, Dahe, were occupied, and Alzurian and Lycroan, Ashain Leaders were tried for war crimes.

pages.title: Rusiguii Republic
pages.intro: The Rusiguii Republic, officially known at the time as the Rusiguii Province, was an independent state in East Atirha that existed from March 15th 1642. The state was founded in March 1642, when delegates from 12 towns met and declared independence from the jurisdictions and land claims of the Merelan Empire's, it was the catalist for the the start of the Etirhan Independence War. On March 4, 1647, it was admitted into Etirha as the Province of Rusigui, with the constitution and laws of the independent state continuing in effect after admission.

pages.title: Ryska River
pages.intro: thumb|Aerial view of the river Ryska at the borders of Huifarn The Ryska is one of the major rivers of Ayuma. The river begins in the Lydroan province of Grarian in the Amnant mountains. It forms part of the Lydroa-Verusan border, then part of the Merelan-Palinian border. It then flows in western direction through Verusa. Finally, the Ryska turns to flow predominantly south to enter the Palina, eventually emptying into the Rianian Ocean through Merela Sra. It drains an area of 185,000 km2.

pages.title: Sanagara
pages.intro: Sanagara, is a unitary semi-presidential republic located in western Massir. The country is composed of eight federated states and three autonomous city territories. It occupies the majority of the Manu Peninsula, as well as several smaller islands in the Ayre Archipelago, and shares a land border with Dahe to the north and a maritime boundary with Oyreain to the southwest. The capital and largest city is Koyaya, which also serves as the political, economic, and cultural center of the country. As of the most recent census, Sanagara has a population exceeding 38 million, making it the 36th most populous country in the world.

pages.title: Seytinemas
pages.intro: Seytinemas, officially the Republic of Seytinemas, is a country in West Mahea. Situated on around the Lanol River, it shares land borders with Trian to the west, Sivoso and Lieri to the north, Pelugrotoa and Taing to the east, and Chaenia and Dual Cenryia to the south. The Ubrana Sea lies to the east of the mainland. It has a population of over 70 million. Vulna is the nation's capital and largest city.

pages.title: Siana
pages.intro: Siana, officially the Republic of Siana, is a country in West Ayuma. Siana consists of 39 provinces; it borders Darewa and Lycroa to the east, Emara to the south, Merela Sta, Palina and Verusa to the north, and the Rianian Ocean to the west. The official language is Sianan, with Hadan as a secondary official language in the province of Hiyamasa. People from the Siana are also referred to as Cesen.

pages.title: Sunsokua
pages.intro: Sunsokua, officially the Republic of Sunsokua, is a country located in East Mahea. It primarily comprises the island of Hijita, also known as Incolstr, situated in the Haanian Ocean between the Adrad and Praosia seas. Sunsokua lies northwest of Ashain, with Pelugrotoa also to the northwest, and shares land borders to the south with Vayvele, Sadain, and Seiaja. The country covers an area of 737,960 square kilometres (284,928 sq mi). Its geography features central highlands and coastal plains, the latter hosting a major portion of the population. The largest metropolitan area encompasses Hikrum, Old Hikrum City, and Tasicudi. With a population of approximately 80 million, Sunsokua is one of the most densely populated countries in the world.

pages.title: Supercontinent
pages.intro: The Supercontinent is a collection of continents located across the northern and southern hemispheres. It includes Ayuma and Acrola in the north, and Mahea and Massir to the south, The supercontinent covers around of land and with a total of about population of 4,454,200,000 as of 1765, making up around 65% of the global population.

pages.title: Taiylsh Desert
pages.intro: The Taiylsh Desert is a vast, cold desert and grassland region located in central Ayuma. Covering an area of approximately 5,331,000 kilometers squared, it ranks as the second-largest desert in the world. The desert features a mix of rocky plateaus, sparse grasslands, and arid plains, making it a unique ecosystem in contrast to the more commonly known sandy deserts.

pages.title: Taval
pages.intro: Taval, officially the Federal Republic of Taval, is a country in Northern Massir. Located on the Passonin Island Chain, it shares land Ucrua on the mainland. The Diairesi Sea lies to the east of the mainland, the Eashor Sea to the west, and the Vihsanna Ocean to the northwest. Taval claims to have the longest coastline on the continent, spanning thousands of islands from the savanna, mountains and rainforest. It has a population of over 44 million. Suraspa is the nation's capital and third-largest city, beaten by Tamalpura and Chavindora. Taval is considered the cradle of civilisation and the birthplace of democracy, modern philosophy, literature, historiography, political science, major scientific and mathematical principles, theatre, and the idea of international trade. The Ancient Alqirans were organised into various independent city-states and islands, which spanned the Diairesi Sea and Kera Sea.

pages.title: United Delet
pages.intro: United Delet, officially the United Provinces of Delet, is the most populated country in New Ayre. It is also the world's 31st-largest country by area and the seventh-largest by population, with over 212 million people. The country is a federation composed of 17 provinces and a Federal preservation district. Mantraal is the most populous city and capital, followed by Roviri. Delet has the most Alqiran speakers, beating New Misos by over 30 million.

pages.title: Untschalle
pages.intro: thumb|upright=1.5|Untschalle steppeThe Untschalle Steppe, also called the Ayuman Steppe or The Steppe, is an area of grassland in Ayuma that is mostly located in the temperate grasslands, savannas, and shrublands biome. It stretches some 4,500 kilometres (2,796 miles) from Heiso in the east through Estijan, Ikzen, Urbiqu, Lydroa, Darewa, Tonder, to Eldjo and Praesyu in the southwest.

pages.title: Valmiran Mountains
pages.intro: thumb|400x400px|Dantedan mountain lakes, Valmiran Mountains, [[Areoix Lie]] The Valmiran Mountains are a mountain range at the intersection of Ayuma and Acrola. Stretching between the Great Hinsakian Ocean and the Tasa Bay, they are surrounded by the Valmiran region and are home to Mount Maecal, the highest peak in Ayuma, and the second tallest in Acrola at above sea level.

pages.title: Verste
pages.intro: Verste, officially the Federal Republic of Verste is a country in Quia. Located on the western edge of the continent, it covers the bulk of the Bay of Screti. It has a land area of about 1,193,527 km2 (460,823 sq mi), making it the thirty-third-largest country and the 10th-largest in Quia. It is bordered by the Doulu sea and Haanian Ocean to the west; Ahokini, and Quidic to the north; Yihnurda to the east; and United Mihili to the southeast. Most of its terrain consists of farms and lowland, steppe, and mountains. The capital and largest city is Kiamlo; other major cities include Ralut and Zelvori, the holiest city in ______. With a population of almost 53.3 million, Verste is the fifth most populous country on the continent.

pages.title: Verusa
pages.intro: Verusa, officially the Federal Republic of Verusa, is a country in northern Ayuma. It nect to the Rianian Ocean. Its thirteen constituent states have a total population of over 69 million in an area of 730,606 km2 (282,089 sq mi) making it the sixth most populous country on Ayuma. Verusa borders Fermori to the north, Uularin and the Lydroa to the east, Darewa and Siana to the south, and Palina, and Yaxuto to the west. The nation's capital and most populous city is Huifarn and its largest urban area is the Epass.
